[!cgo] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build ./...
! stderr .
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'plain\.go:3:.*\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr 'bridge\.go:6:.*\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
! stderr '_cgo_|\.cgo1\.go'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=2 '"rule_id":"correctness::typed_nil_return"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*plain/plain\.go","span":\{"start_line":3,'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*only/bridge\.go","span":\{"start_line":6,'
! stderr '_cgo_|\.cgo1\.go'
logos build ./...
! stderr .
! logos lint ./...
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::typed_nil_return\]'
! stderr '_cgo_|\.cgo1\.go'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cgolint

go 1.27

-- m/plain/bridge.go --
package plain

import "C"

type T struct { N C.int }

-- m/plain/plain.go --
package plain

func Bad() any { return (*T)(nil) }

-- m/only/bridge.go --
package only

import "C"

type T struct { N C.int }
func Bad() any { return (*T)(nil) }
